settings.title: Agent
settings.description: Configure Agent apps, providers, execution limits, storage, and safety controls.

feature.title: Agent feature
feature.description: Controls whether the Agent Host accepts and schedules new execution work. Historical data and maintenance remain available when disabled.

onboarding.title: Enable Agent with Nexus Agent
onboarding.description: Nexus will install the official Nexus Agent plugin from the signed first-party catalog, grant its declared capabilities, and enable it as the default Agent app. The plugin contains the signed Operations and Developer Skills and remains independently installable and upgradable after this step.

apps.title: Agent apps
apps.description: Enable or disable each Agent app independently. Disabling one app does not stop other apps.
apps.permissionsHint: Only manifest-declared capabilities can be granted. Changes take effect only after you save them.
apps.noCapabilities: This app does not declare any grantable capabilities.
apps.permissionsCollapsedHint: Expand to review and edit this app’s capability grants.

plugins.title: Installable apps and skills
plugins.description: Trust publisher keys explicitly, verify signed packages, and manage installed Agent apps. Package code is immutable; app data is kept separately.
plugins.publisherHint: Import an Ed25519 public key only after you have verified its fingerprint with the publisher.
plugins.noPublishers: No publisher keys have been trusted.
plugins.packageHint: The package is uploaded as an Artifact, then checked for signature, hashes, unsafe archive entries, manifest compatibility, and size limits before installation.
plugins.noCandidate: Choose a .tar package to verify it before installation.
plugins.noneInstalled: No installable plugins are currently installed.
plugins.retainedDataHint: Uninstalling code does not delete AppStorage. Data deletion is a separate destructive action.
plugins.deleteDataWarning: This permanently deletes the retained AppStorage for this app. Plugin code is already uninstalled and this data cannot be recovered from Nexus after deletion.

notices.pluginInstalled: Plugin installed. It starts disabled with no grants.
notices.pluginDraining: New Runs are paused while existing Runs finish. Continue the operation after they drain.
notices.pluginUninstalledDataRetained: Plugin code uninstalled. App data was retained.

plugins.remoteRepositoriesHint: The Nexus first-party catalog is pinned by the Host. Additional repositories provide discovery only and require an explicitly trusted Ed25519 publisher before installation.

hardLimits.title: Hard Limits
hardLimits.description: Instance policy ceilings. Every change requires preview and explicit confirmation.
hardLimits.confirmDescription: Review {count} changes. {runtimes} runtimes are currently executing.

performance.title: Execution and performance
performance.description: Requested concurrency is bounded by Hard Limits. Lower values affect future claims without killing work already running.

budget.title: Budget and context
budget.description: Soft Run budgets and context limits. Runs pause for explicit budget increases instead of silently failing.

storage.title: Artifacts and storage
storage.description: Configure requested Artifact quotas and review current storage usage.
storage.hardLimitHint: Requested storage values remain bounded by the corresponding Hard Limits.

workspaceRuntime.title: Workspace dev environment
workspaceRuntime.description: Manage the Agent Runner, Workspace profiles, shared multi-version Tool Packs, storage, and runtime cleanup.
workspaceRuntime.selectRecipe: Select at least one Workspace profile.
workspaceRuntime.setupDescription: Enable the Workspace dev profile and prepare its exact Tool Packs. Enabled and installed are tracked separately.
workspaceRuntime.resetImpact: This restores Workspace profile and tool-version preferences to release defaults. Artifacts and Providers are not changed.
workspaceRuntime.resetComplete: Workspace Runtime settings restored to defaults.
workspaceRuntime.uninstallImpact: Releases about {bytes}. In use: {inUse}. Replacement default: {replacement}.

safety.title: Safety and network
safety.description: Manage Agent-only target deny rules. Core security guardrails cannot be disabled.
safety.guardrails: CSRF protection, capability authorization, cross-App isolation, private-network controls, and mutation approval boundaries are mandatory.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.description: Configure OpenAI-compatible providers. Credentials are stored separately and are never returned by the API.
providers.name: Display name
providers.defaultModelHint: This initializes the model picker for a new Run. Each started Run still freezes its own model snapshot.
providers.discoveryHint: Discovery only trusts model identifiers. Confirm context, output, and tool capability before adding a model.

guardrails.title: System guardrails
guardrails.description: Read-only protocol and persistence safety limits. These are not ordinary user settings.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Run-scoped delegation limits for child agents, durable mailbox traffic, and shared collaboration budgets.
subagents.profileHint: Profiles freeze their model and capability ceiling when a child is created. Current App grants and the parent grant are checked again at execution time.
subagents.peerSameRun: Any authorized peer in the same Run
subagents.noProfiles: No Subagent profiles are configured for this App.

browserRuntime.title: Browser Runtime
browserRuntime.description: Configure CDP targets used by the single Backend BrowserRuntime. Endpoint network scope and reachability path are independent; via=runner uses Runner only as a network tunnel.
browserRuntime.empty: No browser targets configured. External CDP reachable by Backend can work without Runner using via=backend.
browserRuntime.allowedUrls: Allowed page URL patterns (one per line)
browserRuntime.endpointHint: scope describes where the endpoint lives; via selects direct Backend access or a Runner tunnel. v1 rejects credentials in URL userinfo, query, or fragment.

acpRuntime.title: ACP Runtime
acpRuntime.description: Configure ACP process profiles that may run inside Workspaces and ACP integrations exposed to Nexus Agent. ACP processes are bound to the frozen Workspace generation/runtime profile; the single-user native Runner does not claim per-process read-only or network sandboxing.
acpRuntime.profilesHint: argv is a JSON string array; cwd must be under /workspace. Saved profiles can be selected and frozen when a Workspace generation is created.
acpRuntime.integrationsHint: An integration is the Agent-facing logical entry and references a saved Workspace profile. Execution still requires a running Workspace containing that profile.
acpRuntime.saveProfileFirst: Save at least one ACP profile before creating an integration.
acpRuntime.installAgentFirst: Install the Nexus Agent plugin before managing ACP integrations. Workspace ACP profiles can still be configured in advance.

groupDescriptions.overview: Feature state, installed Agent apps, app activity, and capability grants.
groupDescriptions.models: Default model, providers, context budgets, and instance ceilings.
groupDescriptions.execution: Concurrency, performance, and Subagent profiles for delegated work.
groupDescriptions.environments: Workspace Runner, browser targets, and ACP process integrations.
groupDescriptions.storage: Artifact quotas, retention, and current storage pressure.
groupDescriptions.extensions: Signed Agent apps, plugin repositories, packages, and publisher trust.
groupDescriptions.safety: Target deny rules and read-only system guardrails.

hub.title: Agent
hub.appUnavailable: This Agent app does not have a local presentation.
hub.noSurface: This Agent App does not provide an interactive surface.

pluginFrontend.unavailable: This plugin UI is unavailable or could not establish an isolated host bridge.

operations.targetsHint: Choose targets before starting a new Run. The server still enforces Agent grants and the denylist.
operations.reconciliationRequired: This Run requires reconciliation before another mutation can be sent.
operations.runModelHint: Choose the model for the next Run.
operations.runModelLocked: The model is frozen while the current Run is active.
operations.environmentHint: Choose the Workspace Runtime environment for the next Run. Active Run environment state is immutable.
operations.environmentDefaultsHint: The selection is validated against the current Runner catalog and Agent settings when the Run is created, then frozen into its Run definition.
operations.environmentNoneHint: Run without a Workspace environment. Workspace creation is unavailable for this Run.
operations.environmentRunContract: Workspace creation consumes this Run's frozen Environment snapshot; recipe and toolchain choices cannot change mid-Run.

files.cleanupPreview: Delete {count} reclaimable files ({bytes}). {protected} protected files will not be deleted.
files.libraryHint: Durable artifacts, evidence, and files shared with Agent runs.
files.empty: No files match the current filters.

conversation.placeholder: Ask Agent to inspect, diagnose, or explain...
conversation.emptyTitle: Start with the outcome, not the interface
conversation.emptyDescription: Describe the result you want. Agent will work with the current context, authorized tools, and verifiable evidence.

commands.unknown: Unknown command: {command}. Use /help to see commands, or prefix // to send a literal slash message.
commands.attachmentsUnsupported: Slash commands do not accept file attachments. Remove the attachments and try again.
commands.requiresRun: This command requires a Run in the current conversation.
commands.requiresActiveRun: This command requires an active Run.
commands.goalEmpty: No explicit goal has been set for this Run.
commands.planEmpty: The durable plan currently has no items.
commands.queueMoved: Moved pending input from position {from} to {to}.
commands.queueReorderTooLarge: The pending queue is larger than the command view. Reduce it before reordering by position.
commands.interruptSubmitted: The interrupt input was durably appended to the streaming Root model. The current model step is being superseded and rescheduled at a safe boundary.
commands.stopSubmitted: Cancellation was requested for the active Run.
commands.helpGoal: Show the current durable goal, or set a new goal.
commands.helpQueue: Inspect, remove, or reorder durable pending user inputs by position.
commands.helpInterrupt: Append input and supersede only a streaming Root model.
commands.escapeHint: Prefix a message with // to send a literal leading slash.
commands.goalStarted: Started a new Run with durable Goal revision {revision}.
commands.queueTruncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} pending inputs.
commands.notStreaming: /interrupt only works while the Root model is actively streaming.
commands.goalNotAccepted: The current Run can no longer accept goal updates.
commands.stateChanged: The Run changed while the command was being applied. Its latest state has been refreshed; retry the command.
commands.genericFailure: The command could not be applied.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.checkpointHint: Facts only: active leases, tokens, containers, and processes are never saved.
tasks.deleteRunHint: Remove this terminal Run from Agent history. This cannot be undone.

attention.reconciliation: Reconciliation is required before the next mutation.
attention.approval: This run is waiting for your approval.
attention.budget: This run is paused until its budget is increased.

workspaceRuntime.title: Workspace dev environment
workspaceRuntime.description: One Workspace keeps stable project files while each runtime generation composes Node, Python, Go, and Runner Plugin versions.
workspaceRuntime.toolVersionsHint: Optional tools are mounted by version from the shared read-only Tool Store. Different Workspaces can use different versions.
workspaceRuntime.workspaceToolVersionsHint: Switching a version recreates only this Workspace runtime generation; project files and other Workspaces are unchanged.
workspaceRuntime.versionSwitchUnknown: Workspace tool version switch outcome is unknown and must be reconciled before continuing.
workspaceRuntime.runnerPluginsHint: Targets are explicit and frozen into the Workspace profile. Plugins do not create Docker containers.
workspaceRuntime.noRunnerPlugins: No enabled installed Plugin exposes a Runner target.
workspaceRuntime.selectArtifact: Choose a ready Artifact from this App
workspaceRuntime.oneWorkspacePerRuntime: A runtime owns at most one active Workspace. Delete it before creating a replacement.
workspaceRuntime.reconciliationRequired: A Workspace command has an unknown outcome. Verify it before sending another mutation.
workspaceRuntime.reconciliationPending: The Workspace command outcome is still unknown. The original mutation was not retried.
workspaceRuntime.localTerminalHint: Open a direct PTY terminal for this Workspace generation.
workspaceRuntime.browserTargetHint: When selected, the target configuration is frozen into this Workspace generation.
workspaceRuntime.acpProfilesHint: Select ACP workspace profiles that may start inside this Workspace generation.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Public collaboration state only. Private child prompts and model context are not shown here.
subagents.empty: No child delegations for this run.
subagents.noMessages: No public messages for this child.
